'''March 2000 Normal tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Normal, Illinois on 11 March 2000. It is known from Steve Kuperman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d345">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-13-wheaton-illinois-3-12-2000d345/ wheaton-illinois-3-12-2000], DeckTech (Steve "Crazy Hermit" Kuperman, 13 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-13-wheaton-illinois-3-12-2000d345/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 March 2000
* '''Site:''' Normal, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
